# Decisions: <name>

Why <name> is built the way it is. Decisions that bind every app are in the root [`docs/DECISIONS.md`](../../../docs/DECISIONS.md).

One bullet per decision, under its area, oldest first: what was chosen, the numbers that chose it, and *[where they came from]* (a milestone of the app that drove it, a code review, a results file under `apps/<app>/perf/results/`). A decision that replaces another marks the old one *Superseded* rather than deleting it. Decisions moved here from an app keep their dates and sources.
